name: 钱学森
title: 中国航天之父、中国导弹之父
titleEn: Father of Chinese Aerospace and Missile Programs
description: 世界著名空气动力学家，中国载人航天奠基人，"两弹一星"功勋奖章获得者。
descriptionEn: World-renowned aerodynamicist, founder of China's manned space program, "Two Bombs, One Satellite" medal recipient.

quotes.text: 我的事业在中国，我的成就在中国，我的归宿在中国。
quotes.textEn: My career is in China, my achievements are in China, my destination is in China.

quotes.text: 在美国期间，有人好几次问我存了保险金没有，我说一块美元也不存。
quotes.textEn: During my time in the US, I was asked several times if I had saved any insurance money. I said I hadn't saved a single dollar.
quotes.sourceEn: Recalling his time in the US

quotes.text: 因为我是中国人，根本不打算在美国住一辈子。
quotes.textEn: Because I am a Chinese, I never intended to live in America forever.
quotes.sourceEn: Recalling his time in the US

quotes.text: 我在美国前三四年是学习，后十几年是工作，所有这一切都在做准备，为了回到祖国后能为人民做点事。
quotes.textEn: My first three or four years in America were for study, the next ten-odd years for work. All of this was preparation, so that after returning to the motherland I could do something for the people.
quotes.sourceEn: Recalling his time in the US

quotes.text: 我很高兴能回到自己的国家，我不打算再回美国，今后我将竭尽努力，和中国人民一道建设自己的国家，使我的同胞能过上有尊严的幸福生活。
quotes.textEn: I am very happy to be back in my own country. I do not plan to go back to America. I will do my utmost to build our country together with the Chinese people, so that my compatriots can live a life of dignity and happiness.

quotes.text: 科学上没有平坦的大道，只有不畏劳苦沿着陡峭山路攀登的人，才有希望达到光辉的顶点。
quotes.textEn: There is no smooth road in science. Only those who are not afraid of hard work and climb the steep mountain paths have hope of reaching the brilliant summit.

quotes.text: 不要失去信心，只要坚持不懈，就终会有成果的。
quotes.textEn: Don't lose confidence. As long as you persevere, you will eventually achieve results.

quotes.text: 正确的结果，是从大量错误中得出来的；没有大量错误作台阶，也就登不上最后正确结果的高座。
quotes.textEn: Correct results come from a large number of mistakes; without a large number of mistakes as stepping stones, one cannot reach the high seat of final correct results.

quotes.text: 常常是最后一把钥匙打开了门。
quotes.textEn: It is often the last key that opens the door.

quotes.text: 我作为一名中国的科技工作者，活着的目的就是为人民服务。
quotes.textEn: As a Chinese scientific and technological worker, the purpose of my life is to serve the people.

quotes.text: 我们不能人云亦云，这不是科学精神，科学精神最重要的就是创新。
quotes.textEn: We cannot just follow what others say. This is not the scientific spirit. The most important thing in the scientific spirit is innovation.

quotes.text: 难道搞科学的人只需要数据和公式吗？搞科学的人同样需要有灵感，而我的灵感，许多就是来自于艺术。
quotes.textEn: Do people who do science only need data and formulas? Scientists also need inspiration, and much of my inspiration comes from art.
quotes.source: 关于科学与艺术的谈话
